title: LarpHub: OP (BETA) LEVEL FARM AND AUTO WIN
features:

This script logs: Username, PlayerId, JobId, gameid, GameID and what script you executed! There's an extra warning when executing incase you didnt see this!)
This Script is in Beta!
* OP LEVEL FARM: Teleports you at 0,500,0 and then you just farm levels, this works by replicating the W key and the space bar key (When jumping it for some reason just gives you more jumps when you upgrade so idk)

* AUTO WIN (Endless): This will never stop until you disable it but it will teleport you to the winpads, this is capped at 3K, more comming soon to this

* Fly: Free-fly with W/A/S/D + Space/Ctrl.
* Noclip:	Walk through walls.
* Infinite:  Jump	Re-jump anytime.
* Walk Speed / Jump Power / Fly Speed: Sliders to change movement stats.
* Win Travel Speed / Win Height	Tune: how fast and how high Auto Win flies.
* Reset Button: incase you get stuck in the void
